feed_acquaintances_detail: Long-form from follows of your follows
feed_global_detail: Use at your own discretion: this feed is prone to unsafe content.
empty_on_device: Nothing on this device yet. Add an EPUB, PDF or text file from the Add tab.
empty_following_anon: Sign in to see long-form from people you follow.
empty_acquaintances_anon: Sign in to see long-form from the next hop of your follows.
empty_following_nobody: You are not following anyone yet, so this shelf is empty. Follow a few writers in any nostr client, or open Global at your own discretion.
empty_acquaintances: No acquaintances yet. Follow a few people; their contacts will fill this shelf.
empty_global: No books found on the connected relays yet.
empty_list: Nobody in this list has published a book the connected relays carry.
onboard_welcome_1: Athena is a reader and a shelf for long-form writing on nostr. Articles arrive as NIP-23 events; books as NKBIP-01 publications. You can also import an EPUB, PDF or text file and keep it on this device.
onboard_welcome_2: Sign in with Amber (or a bunker) to highlight passages, follow writers, and publish. Your private key never enters this app — Amber or the bunker signs on your behalf.
onboard_welcome_3: Reading needs no account. Relays only see what you choose to publish.
onboard_login_body: Amber is a NIP-55 signer: it holds your keys and answers when this app needs a signature. Athena never sees the private key.
onboard_no_amber: No Amber (or other NIP-55 signer) is installed on this device. On the desktop, connect a bunker instead.
onboard_relays_body: Pick the relays Athena should ask for books. You can change this later in Settings.
bunker_approval_body: Open this page, approve Athena, then try again:
settings_signin_blurb: You can read everything without an account. Sign in to keep highlights, favourites and your reading position across devices.
settings_no_amber: No NIP-55 signer found on this device.
sync_off_detail: Private highlights and reading positions stay on this device. Nothing about them reaches a relay.
sync_passphrase_detail: Sync across devices with nothing published to find. Enter the same passphrase on each device.
sync_auto_detail: No passphrase to remember, but a relay can then work out that this account uses Athena.
sync_unlocked: This device is unlocked for sync.
error_relay_url: A relay URL starts with wss:// and has no credentials in it.
error_passphrase_short: Use at least %1$d characters — this is the only thing protecting your sync slots from offline guessing.
error_sign_in_first: Sign in first, then set a sync passphrase.
error_pick_relay: Pick at least one relay, or add your own.
error_file_too_large: That file is larger than %1$d MB.
error_unsupported_type: Athena does not read %1$s files yet. Try PDF, EPUB or plain text.
error_scanned_pdf: This PDF has no extractable text. Scanned pages cannot go on the relays.
error_unreadable_file: That file could not be read as a book.
error_sign_in_publish: Sign in before publishing a book.
reader_hub_empty: Open a book from the Library, or add a file, to start reading. The page-turn, type size and fonts below apply the next time a book is open.
reader_paged_hint: Swipe sideways to turn the page.
reader_scroll_hint: Scroll or use Page Up / Page Down.
reader_missing: The relays did not return this book's text. Try again, or add a relay that carries it.
highlights_empty_in: Highlight a passage while reading and it shows up here.
highlights_empty_out: Sign in to keep your highlights across devices.
import_drop_another: Drop another file, or click to choose
import_formats: PDF, EPUB or plain text — published in the clear on the relays
import_public_detail: Anyone on nostr, in any client. For public-domain works, or writing that is yours to share.
import_private_detail: Encrypted to your key at a blinded address: your other devices, and nobody else. For books you own but may not republish.
import_published_body: It is on the relays and already in your library.
